existing_group_assignments.rationale: Oxidative DNA damage is a specific form of increased DNA damage, same direction, so it fits the general-versus-specific context group.
Increased DNA damage and mutation is the same direction as general DNA damage increase, with added specificity (mutation).
Population trajectory decline is the same endpoint as Decline, Population, and is opposite in direction to Increased, Population.

new_groups.rationale: Decreased atRA concentration, decreased RAR activation and decreased ALDH1A activity all concern the retinoic acid signaling axis but are distinct molecules and processes, so they are flagged for curator review.
Both concern the GnRH receptor; promoter hypermethylation and decreased expression are distinct processes.
LH receptor antagonism and impaired ovulation are not the same object, so this should be omitted.
